name: gse39582_cimp_specificity
question: is the CIMP association with GUCA2A locus-specific or axis-level
estimand: mean[log2 target - log2 reference | CIMP+] - same | CIMP-
decision_rule: support requires BOTH references, intervals excluding zero
expected_before_running: not specific; references disagree in direction
verdict: NOT SPECIFIC: support needs both references and 0 of 2 favour GUCA2A -- CDX2 +0.544 [+0.219, +0.878], MS4A12 -0.147 [-0.514, +0.205]. The methylator association reads as axis-level or compositional, not locus-specific.
cannot_establish: Bulk is fraction x per-cell mean, so no outcome here separates silencing from colonocyte-specific compositional loss. A null closes a route; a positive only promotes the question to a leg with the same structure.
